- Converts our current buckets to X seats (we attached a spreadsheet with current usages)
- Shows prorated billing for the transition month
- Notes any changes to SLA or burst credits

Attached: MedWork_migration_requirements.xlsx (breakdown of usage by team). Please let me know what you need from procurement/legal to move forward. We’re aiming for a Nov 1 effective date if feasible.

Thanks,

Thanks, Irene and Elena. Quick pricing note — based on the usage sheet, we recommend migrating to 120 seats to preserve concurrency for the highest-volume teams. Attached is a short commercial proposal showing gross-to-net and a monthly run-rate: proposal-seat-pricing.pdf.

Proration: we usually bill prorated for the remainder of the month based on the effective date (days remaining in the billing cycle). Two options:
- Option A (preferred): Prorate to Nov 1 (no double billing for October), new rate applies from Nov 1 onward;
- Option B: Start billing for seats on the first full billing cycle after deployment (Dec 1) and provide a one-time transition credit for November.

Notes for legal redline: we’ll need an explicit line replacing 'Usage buckets' with 'Seat licenses' in Exhibit A, and an amendment clause clarifying burst credits and any seat reassignment policy.

Attaching proposal-seat-pricing.pdf. Laura — can you confirm billing contact and invoicing flow so we can call out the right PO and billing email?

- Karthik

Jordan — thanks for the quick turnaround. A few responses inline:
- Seat reassignment: MedWork needs the ability to move seats between teams without an additional fee (we reallocate often). If there needs to be a notice window for audit purposes, 7 days would be acceptable.
- Overage cap: we can accept overage charges, but request a soft cap for the first 60 days to avoid unexpected spikes during cutover.
- SOC 2: no changes required from our side; we just want to ensure that logs tied to seat ownership are preserved.

We’re fine with Option A proration and Nov 1 effective date. Please send the clean amendment for signature and include a DocuSign link.

Elena
